confidence_notes: The _p_net_same_laser helper function computes p_gross = p_fus * eta_th * mn (thermal channel only), explicitly noting in a comment that this approximates the hybrid case only because ETA_TH == ETA_DEC = 0.44 in this model. If the two efficiencies diverge in a future revision, this function will silently undercount gross power.

The _q_eng_from_gain helper uses eta_th=ETA_TH as a default parameter and ignores eta_de entirely; it is used in the (G, f_rep) scenario grids (F-1, F-2), not in the canonical costingfe.forward() path. Q-only calculations without DEC are physically acceptable here but would need updating if DEC efficiency meaningfully affects the recirculating power fraction.

DEC capital cost (C220109) is explicitly $0 in the base model (framework DEC cost for IFE not implemented; TRL 1-2). The power-conversion DEC channel is live via pulsed_thermal_forward with eta_de=0.44, but the capital cost is absent, making all reported LCOE values a lower bound.

Both DEVIATION annotations correctly identify direction of deviation against canonical (eta_th: observed 0.44 > canonical 0.35; eta_de: observed 0.44 < canonical 0.54) and carry source citations. The hybrid wiring is explicit: pulsed_conversion=THERMAL with f_dec=0.30, eta_de=ETA_DEC in _SHARED_KWARGS feeding both canonical model.forward() calls.
